changelog:
- Initial release of the cn-tendering-agent skill, an expert system for the full lifecycle of construction engineering tendering and procurement agency in China.
- Provides comprehensive workflows and templates for: service scheme design, tender planning, client requirements management, tender document preparation and review, bid evaluation organization, risk management, contract and cost control, and project quality and progress management.
- Supports multiple practical scenarios, including agency service proposal drafting, tender planning and section division, needs analysis, bidding document preparation, bid evaluation, risk assessment, and project management.
- Includes detailed guides, process breakdowns, key workflows, and output formats to standardize and streamline agency work.
- Cites relevant legal bases and outlines reference resources for extended guidance.
- Defines scope boundaries and usage scenarios for compliance with domestic and international bidding requirements.
